name: Gekkomon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Glowing Dawn] trait and 1 green card with the [BEATBREAK] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.)
